title: UDLF deployment config — Splunk Enterprise
description: Config for `platform: splunk`. Splunk Enterprise via a deployer-built app, producing savedsearches.conf stanzas. No ES features.

schema.description: Sub-schema revision this block was authored against, e.g. `splunk::0.2.0`.

severity.description: Severity for this deployment. Optional, overrides `detection_context.severity`. Maps to `alert.severity`.

schedule.description: When the saved search runs. Supply exactly one of `cron` or `frequency`.

cron.description: Cron expression for the search. Maps to `cron_schedule`.

frequency.description: Recurring interval, expanded to cron by the deployer. Splunk allows 1-59m, 1-23h or 1-30d; use `cron` for anything else.

lookback.description: Start of the search window, a Splunk relative-time modifier. Maps to `dispatch.earliest_time`.

latest_time.description: End of the search window, a Splunk relative-time modifier. Maps to `dispatch.latest_time`.

schedule_window.description: How far the scheduler may delay this search. Maps to `schedule_window`. `auto` lets Splunk choose.

suppression.description: Alert throttling: discard repeat alerts sharing the same `fields` values within `window`. Maps to `alert.suppress.*`.

fields.description: Fields whose matching values identify a duplicate alert. Each must be produced by the search.

items.description: A field name. No spaces: the conf value is comma-delimited and unquoted.

window.description: How long duplicate alerts are suppressed. Maps to `alert.suppress.period`.

threshold.description: Events that must be exceeded within the search window before the alert fires. 0 fires on any result.

advanced.description: Escape hatch for unmodelled savedsearches.conf keys. Passed through verbatim and unvalidated; prefer a modelled field.
